def finish_parse(self, last_lineno_seen):
        """Clean-up/summary tasks run at the end of parsing."""
        if self.lineno != last_lineno_seen:
            # We've got a trailing comment
            self.lineno = last_lineno_seen
            self.add_token(Token.NEWLINE)
        self.add_token(Token.ENDMARKER)
        self.tokens.reverse()
        return self.tokens
